name: Server Dashboard
author: fredde
description: Live stats for a server over SSH on Tailscale: CPU, memory, disks, temperature, network, Docker containers and failed services, with restart, reboot and terminal actions.

barWidget.description: Server stats in the bar (pick which, or none), and a compact themed dashboard that expands to graphs, storage, containers and processes.

schema.label: SSH target
schema.description: user@host, for example casaos@100.64.0.10. A Tailscale IP or MagicDNS name works. The password is stored in the keyring from the panel.

schema.label: Display name
schema.description: Leave empty to use the server's hostname.

schema.label: Show root disk usage in the bar
Show CPU temperature in the bar
Show network rates in the bar
schema.description: Turn every bar stat off to show only the server icon.

schema.label: Open the panel expanded
schema.description: Show graphs, storage, containers and processes without pressing More.

schema.label: Notify me
schema.description: A desktop notification when the server drops or comes back, a container turns unhealthy, a disk passes 90% or a service fails.

schema.label: Check for updates automatically
schema.description: Looks on GitHub every few hours; updating is always your click, in the panel's settings.
